subject: The ONLY source any Arts Award deck, staff block or gate may cite.

provenance.rule: If the Trinity PDFs are later placed in the repo, vendor them with sha256 and cite them. Until then this file IS the spec.
provenance.notASource: The z-fold leaflet. Its PDF text mis-orders the qualification numbers.
provenance.exemplarsAreNotSources: The uploaded SoWs, worksheets and 44 exemplar decks are EXEMPLARS ONLY - never a donor, never a spec source, never copied.

universal.noGrades: Results are Pass / Below Pass only. No grades, no marks language anywhere.
universal.adviserMustNot: Advisers must not write plans, reviews or evidence for pupils.
universal.moderation: Moderators do NOT reassess work; they check the adviser's marking for consistency.

portfolio.refused: "in arts log" is refused as a locator

universal.assessorRule: Only an adviser trained at that level may assess.
universal.centreRule: Delivery is through a validated centre. State as staff information; never assert as done.

differentiationLadder.warning: Never confuse with the Explore / Bronze / Silver / Gold ladder.

Explore.title: Entry Level Award in the Arts
Explore.unitStructure: four parts, each a DISTINCT activity

A.name: Take part
A.requires: at least two arts activities; identify what they learnt

B.name: Explore
B.requires: at least one artist AND at least one arts ORGANISATION, through live or active experience
B.note: Desk research alone fails. "Active participation" means beyond desk research only.

C.name: Create
C.requires: an artwork, a record of the PROCESS, and the final work

D.name: Share
D.requires: communicate personal enjoyment or achievement, chosen by looking back at A-C

Explore.attemptedRule: Overall Pass allows ONE Attempted. Any Not Attempted = Below Pass.

Bronze.title: Level 1 Award in the Arts

A.name: Explore the arts as a participant
A.requires: active participation in any art form; improvement; a summary of what they learnt

B.name: Explore the arts as an audience member
B.requires: attend at least one arts event or experience; reflect on quality and creative impact; views SHARED with at least one other person, evidenced

C.name: Arts inspiration
C.requires: simple research into an artist, craftsperson or practitioner's practice, career, life and work; why chosen

D.name: Arts skills share
D.requires: plan, then deliver a short workshop or presentation passing on an arts skill, then review how well it went

Bronze.attemptedRule: ONE Attempted allowed overall. Any Not Attempted = Below Pass.

Silver.title: Level 2 Award in the Arts

1A.name: Plan an arts challenge
1A.requires: own strengths and weaknesses; an own action plan
1A.note: The challenge must NOT focus on leadership. The adviser must not write the plan.

1B.name: Implement and review the arts challenge
1B.requires: ongoing evidence; someone ELSE's review of the challenge; the pupil's own final review

1C.name: Review arts events
1C.requires: at least one event or experience attended AS AN AUDIENCE MEMBER; a review of artistic qualities and creative impact; the review SHARED, evidenced

1D.name: Arts research
1D.requires: MEET arts practitioners and gain first-hand experience through workshops or events; research arts organisations; education AND career pathways; a summary in the pupil's own words of the influence

2A.name: Plan the project and own leadership role

2B.name: Plan practical issues
2B.requires: promotion, recruitment, resources, risk, feedback plan

Silver.attemptedRule: ONE Attempted allowed PER UNIT. Any Not Attempted = Below Pass.

Gold.title: Level 3 Certificate in the Arts

1A.name: Extend own arts practice
1A.requires: main art form named; skills developed in a NEW art form, genre or practice; a skills plan; working with a practitioner experienced in the new practice; a new artwork; shared; feedback; a review of the influence on the main practice

1B.name: Career development opportunities
1B.requires: research; a placement, volunteering, training or workshop actually done; reflection; comments from the practitioners who led it

1C.name: Research practitioners and review arts events
1C.requires: active research into more advanced practitioners and the organisations supporting them, including contact made; reviews of arts events or experiences attended; reflection

1D.name: Arts issue
1D.requires: the issue and why; research into a RANGE of views including ones differing from their own; reflection; the final argument; evidence it was shared, plus feedback

2A.name: Aims and outcomes
2A.requires: leader qualities; own distinct role; skills to develop; the project; monitoring and feedback plans; a public showing as part of the stimulus

2B.name: Organise people and resources
2B.requires: timescales, promotion, delivery, public-showing plans, risk assessment, health and safety, other legislation including licensing and insurance where relevant, budget and funding where relevant, an evaluation plan

2D.name: Manage a PUBLIC showing
2D.requires: arrangements, promotion, delivery, own responsibilities, feedback from participants AND audience

Gold.assessmentNote: Advisers look across the whole portfolio for one notable example of each area.

pathways.rule: Matt's rule: Explore/Bronze = BUILD, maybe GROW; Bronze/Silver = GROW, maybe LAUNCH; Gold = LAUNCH only.

secondaryPlacement.meaning: a catalogue or hub row pointing at the SAME deck; never a second or re-banded copy; zero lesson units

readingBands.LAUNCH: per the LAUNCH band ruling (ceiling only, 14.21)

pathways.bandFlowsDownOnly: A deck may be placed in a pathway whose band is at or above its own, never below. A placement row whose deck's measured band exceeds the pathway band REDS.
pathways.secondaryCellReading: SERVED-BY-PLACEMENT, not re-claimed. g29 plan-binding holds: one deck, one plan, one cell set.
pathways.languageRule: Simplifying the language for a lower band never lowers the EVIDENCE expectation. Success criteria and evidence prompts keep the toolkit's meaning at every band.

registerCoding: secondary SEMH at every band, never primary-coded
